purpose: Reference sheet for live demonstration. Maps a specific input action to the exact canned response file/record it should trigger, so the demo behaves identically on every run.

scenarios.action: Upload a file named containing 'BHEL' or select plant BHEL-HEEP with a clean sample
scenarios.expected_ui_state: Green validation banner, all 15 records passed, proceed-to-mapping button enabled.

scenarios.action: Upload a file named containing 'SAIL' or select plant SAIL-RSP with the prepared error sample
scenarios.expected_ui_state: Amber/red validation banner, 3 of 12 records failed, field-level error table shown for rows 4 and 7.

scenarios.flow: CPSE Data Steward - New Code Request
scenarios.action: Submit description 'Ball Bearing 6205, Double Shield Type' for plant NTPC-TPS
scenarios.expected_ui_state: Duplicate Prevention Gate shows matched CNMC-BRG-00001 with Trust Score 94 and Reuse/Proceed options.

scenarios.flow: CPSE Data Steward - New Code Request
scenarios.action: Submit description 'Explosion-Proof Junction Box, 20-Way, IP66' for plant IOCL-BR
scenarios.expected_ui_state: No Match Found message; request proceeds directly to Technical Review queue.

scenarios.action: Open group MG-0001 (Ball Bearing 6205 ZZ, BHEL-HEEP vs NTPC-TPS)
scenarios.expected_ui_state: Trust Score 94, Exact Match, side-by-side spec comparison, Approve action available.

scenarios.action: Open the lowest trust-score group in match_results.csv (rejected pump/motor mismatch)
scenarios.expected_ui_state: Trust Score 22, Not a Match, Reject action pre-selected with system rationale shown.

scenarios.action: Open National Analytics Dashboard on login
scenarios.expected_ui_state: Six summary cards, records-by-plant bar chart, migration progress gauge.
